title: Flaky coder tests on macOS: processes_writing_different_tasks_never_wait_on_each_other, a_start_takes_the_spare_at_its_commit_and_a_new_one_is_made
body: Follow-up to #10284 (39b8ea1894, which fixed fd-inheritance flakes: a child process briefly holding another test's lock/binary). These two each failed once in 6 macOS runs of the coder task suite. Find the cause (likely the same inherited-fd/lock pattern, or timing on the spare checkout) and make them deterministic; 10 clean runs on macOS and Linux.
